services.desc: Are you noticing that your child is almost mastering a particular skill but just needs a little extra support? Or perhaps they feel a bit nervous in a classroom setting, or maybe they simply enjoy working with a specific coach. Private gymnastics lessons at The Children's Gym offer a wonderful opportunity for your child to build confidence, sharpen their skills, and boost their abilities. Our Private Lessons are designed to provide personalized, one-on-one instruction that helps your child succeed. services.name: gymnastics classes
services.desc: Our classes are divided into two programs: Preschool Gymnastics Classes (which includes our adult-child classes) and School-Aged Children's Gymnastics Classes. Both programs are non-competitive, co-ed, and separated by age. To learn more about each program and our individual children's gymnastics classes, click the buttons below. Within the school-aged program, we divide the Level 1 classes into three different classes. This helps meet the varying social-emotional needs and developmental changes of school-aged children.
